name: Yabucoa (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided per saltire into purple triangles at the top and bottom and white triangles at the hoist and fly, with a green triangle within each white one.
history: Yabucoa is a town and municipality in eastern Puerto Rico. The abstract design is inspired by the colours of the municipal shield — green, white and violet.

features.role: green triangles at the hoist and fly
